I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is **IT ticket #4092**.

That comes from a message Ilse posted in #north-random. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see it herself. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, and I passed that along. #help-it-ops has no messages about it, so I told Dana I can't confirm whether the ticket is still open.
